segments.name: Owned and Operated IP
segments.description: Digitally native lifestyle and media brand rooted in gaming and youth culture, monetized through sponsorships, consumer products and esports.
segments.evidence: FaZe Esports has several revenue streams including brand sponsorships, consumer products, and Esports.

segments.name: Agency
segments.description: Esports and gaming talent agencies and marketing services that represent creators and broker brand activations for brands.
segments.evidence: GameSquare's Agency Services segment represents esports agencies which include Code Red, GCN, Zoned and Click.

segments.name: SaaS and managed services
segments.description: Software and analytics platforms for creators, marketers and the live streaming industry.
segments.evidence: Stream Hatchet is the leading provider of data analytics for the live streaming industry.

segments.name: Yield
segments.description: Ethereum-based treasury and yield strategy that generates digital asset returns through a partner's platform.
segments.evidence: GameSquare's ETH-focused yield generation strategy is built on top of Dialectic Ellipse Feeder Fund LP's ("Dialectic") proprietary platform Medici, which applies machine learning models, automated optimization, and multi-layered risk controls to generate returns.

revenueModel.text: Global brands pay GameSquare for marketing spend that reaches gaming and creator economy audiences.
revenueModel.evidence: GameSquare's revenue growth is expected to be driven by increasing marketing spend from global brands that seek exposure to and connections with these gaming and creator economy audiences.
